events.what_it_is: A free three-day immersive cat-themed bodega pop-up from TEMPTATIONS celebrating NYC shop cats, with product sampling, games, prizes, merchandise and photo moments.
events.what_is_free: Free TEMPTATIONS Classic Treats and Lickable Puree samples; claw-machine and scratch-off games offer chances to win Cat Bodega merchandise, while supplies last.
events.caveats: TEMPTATIONS and parent company Mars both state that the physical NYC pop-up is free and runs September 17–19 from 12–6 PM daily at 213 Bowery. On-site samples and game pieces/prizes are available while supplies last. No RSVP or ticket requirement is stated on the official event pages.
events.practical_notes: Walk in September 17, 18 or 19 from 12–6 PM at 213 Bowery. The official TEMPTATIONS page lists the same address and hours; arrive earlier if free samples or prizes are the priority because promotional inventory is limited.

events.event_name: CookUnity — The Most Legendary Lunch Break
events.address: Bari Bodega, 873 Broadway; Madison Square Deli & Convenience, 266 W 23rd St; New York Pizza and Cafe, 369 Madison Ave; Sam's Deli, 275 W 4th St; Slice N' Spice Deli & Grill, 451 3rd Ave, New York, NY
events.what_it_is: A one-day CookUnity takeover of five Manhattan bodegas, delis and corner stores where eight chefs serve complimentary CookUnity meals and hot samples during a three-hour lunch pop-up.
events.what_is_free: Complimentary chef-made meals and hot samples while supplies last, plus a bodega-style scratch-off ticket with chances to win CookUnity meals and dining experiences.
events.caveats: Multiple current NYC sources agree on Thursday, September 17, 11:30 AM–2:30 PM, five Manhattan locations and free public walk-in access. Meals and samples are explicitly while supplies last. No RSVP or ticket requirement is published in the verified sources. A first-party CookUnity event page was not located in this pass, so the listing retains the strongest current independent sources rather than inventing an official URL.
events.practical_notes: Thursday, September 17, 11:30 AM–2:30 PM. Participating locations: Bari Bodega (873 Broadway, Flatiron); Madison Square Deli & Convenience (266 W 23rd St, Chelsea); New York Pizza and Cafe (369 Madison Ave, Midtown); Sam's Deli (275 W 4th St, West Village); Slice N' Spice Deli & Grill (451 3rd Ave, Murray Hill). Current coverage recommends arriving before 11:30 because lines and sell-through are expected.
